payload.goal: Optimization technique for NVIDIA Blackwell (SM100): When to Use

problem.statement: Warp Specialization on Blackwell -- When to Use

payload.what: - **Always on Blackwell GEMMs**: Warp specialization is the standard pattern for SM100 tensor core kernels. The tcgen05 instruction model assumes single-thread dispatch with TMEM output. - **Attention kernels**: FlashAttention-4 extends this to ping-pong scheduling with 2 query tile groups and dedicated softmax warps. - **Any kernel with producer-consumer pipeline**: When TMA loads and MMA compute can overlap, warp specialization provides the cleanest decomposition.
payload.when: - **Always on Blackwell GEMMs**: Warp specialization is the standard pattern for SM100 tensor core kernels.
